question.text: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the Investment Manager of Kaveri Macro Fund must file the PPM for its new Cat III scheme through a SEBI-registered Merchant Banker. The minimum period between filing and scheme launch is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5 states: 'the Investment Manager or Sponsor must launch AIF schemes after filing the PPM with SEBI, through a SEBI registered Merchant Banker, at least 30 days prior to launch of scheme, along with payment of scheme fee.' The Trap: Options A/B under-state the filing window. Option D overshoots. The 30-day rule is specifically calibrated to give SEBI time to revert with observations to the merchant banker. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same filing rule. XIX-B (Distributor) tests awareness from a client-disclosure angle. XIX-D tests the analogous PPM rule for Cat I/II schemes.
